method.rent_measure: monthly gross rent including separately paid utilities

variance.authority: NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development

comptroller_reference.source: NYC Comptroller, Spotlight: New York City's Rental Housing Market
comptroller_reference.comparison_note: The public reference uses 2021 contract rent. This product uses 2023 gross rent and the two complete years before the survey, so it reproduces the geographic comparison structure and records changes in direction or scale rather than claiming an exact replication.

space_estimates.denominator: Occupied renter households in the group and geography with valid household size, bedrooms and positive full-sample weight; all rent amounts and move-in years.
